data.desc: Through its Macau operating entity, Companhia de Comercio Luz Limitada ('Luz'), a limited liability company established under the laws of Macau in 2010, Epsium is engaged in the import and wholesale distribution of primarily alcoholic beverages in Macau. The Company's portfolio includes Chinese liquor, French cognac, Scotch whisky, fine wine, Champagne and other beverage alcohol, sold through gaming and hotel groups, supermarkets, restaurants, bars and other channels across Macau.
